findings.problem: The file defines the monoidal structure on `Mat_ C` but gives no canonical simp interface for its entries. It has no entry lemmas for `f ⊗ₘ g`, `X ◁ f`, `f ▷ X`, `(α_ M N K).hom`/`.inv`, or `(λ_ M).hom`/`.inv` and `(ρ_ M).hom`/`.inv`. Its own proofs therefore unfold the private helper definitions with `simp only [..., matTensorHom, matAssociator, matAssocHom, ...]`. The `matMonoidalStruct` instance hides those helpers behind `⊗ₘ`, `◁`, `▷` and `α_`, so a user-facing goal such as `(f ⊗ₘ g) (i₁, i₂) (j₁, j₂)` has no rule that reaches the entry. MatBraided.lean works around this by declaring its own entry lemmas: `mat_tensorHom_apply`, `mat_whiskerLeft_apply`, `mat_whiskerRight_apply`, `mat_assocHom_apply` and `mat_assocInv_apply`. All of them are `private`, so MatRigid.lean and other users cannot reuse them. The unitors have no entry lemmas anywhere.
findings.proposed_change: Add public `@[simp]` entry lemmas (proved by `rfl`) in this file, stated in the user-facing notation, and remove the private copies from MatBraided.lean. The tensor lemma would be `(f ⊗ₘ g : M₁ ⊗ M₂ ⟶ N₁ ⊗ N₂) (i₁, i₂) (j₁, j₂) = f i₁ j₁ ⊗ₘ g i₂ j₂`. Add the matching whiskerLeft/whiskerRight lemmas. For the structural isomorphisms, add `(α_ M N K).hom ((i,j),k) (i',(j',k')) = if hi : i = i' then …`, the `.inv` analogue, and the four unitor lemmas, e.g. `(λ_ M).hom ((), i) j = if h : i = j then eqToHom _ ≫ (λ_ (M.X j)).hom else 0`. Then switch the internal proofs from `simp only [matTensorHom, matAssociator, matAssocHom, …]` to these lemmas. Do not add simp attributes to `mat_comp_*_apply`, since they would compete with `Mat_.comp_apply`.
findings.benefit: Entries of tensor products, whiskerings and structural isomorphisms normalise to the component-level `dite`/`⊗ₘ` forms through one public interface. Downstream files such as MatBraided and MatRigid can then use the lemmas instead of keeping private duplicates. The `rfl` lemmas are non-looping, because their right-hand sides contain no matrix-level `⊗ₘ`, `◁`, `▷` or `α_`. The proofs here also stop depending on the private helper names.
